title: Statue of Liberty
blurb: Bartholdi’s 1886 copper colossus in New York Harbor: 93 m from ground to torch tip, the 46 m figure with its 7-rayed crown and tablet on Hunt’s pedestal inside Fort Wood, over Eiffel’s iron frame.

systems.name: Fort Wood
systems.description: The 11-pointed star fort whose walls the pedestal rises inside (schematic).

systems.name: Pedestal
systems.description: Richard Morris Hunt’s stone pedestal, built by the Americans, carrying Emma Lazarus’s sonnet plaque.

systems.name: Robe
systems.description: The flowing classical drapery of the figure, in hammered copper 2.37 mm thick (schematic form).

systems.name: Crown
systems.description: The crown with 7 rays for the seven seas and continents and 25 windows.

systems.name: Torch
systems.description: The torch of enlightenment with its gold-leafed flame; the tip stands 93 m above the ground.

systems.name: Tablet
systems.description: The tablet inscribed JULY IV MDCCLXXVI, 7.19 m by 4.14 m.

systems.name: Feet and chains
systems.description: The feet with the broken chains of tyranny (schematic).

systems.name: Iron framework
systems.description: Gustave Eiffel’s iron framework inside the copper skin (schematic).
